title: Hong Kong
description: Hollywood Road on foot: a former prison, a stair street of studios, and incense at Man Mo.
footnote: A Saturday morning walk from Tai Kwun to Hollywood Road. Expect stairs.

stops.title: Tai Kwun
stops.description: The old Central Police Station compound. Start in the yard, then slip out toward Hollywood Road.

stops.title: PMQ
stops.description: Studios stacked in the old married-police quarters. Good for a slow look, not a shopping list.

stops.title: Man Mo Temple
stops.description: Coils of incense over a street that still feels older than the towers behind it.
